verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's docs say it can extract content from any URL as markdown, HTML, or structured JSON, and the GitHub README calls its output 'LLM-ready… Clean markdown'. Local files (PDF, DOCX, HTML) can also be converted to Markdown, so developers can request markdown instead of raw HTML. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the markdown is actually clean, and detailed first-party docs on markdown cleaning and formatting options (e.g., boilerplate removal).
